title: NetworkUserReportRequest
description: network.user-report-request@1 (ask 287): POST /api/v1/me/reports on OpenVibe.Network, a signed-in person's report about another person. `target` is their username (any case) or usr_ subject; guests cannot be named, and nobody reports themselves. The same pair may have one open report: filing again while it is open answers the open one with 200 instead of creating a duplicate (201 when it creates one).
